BUG-1173 normalized only exact stk_limit repairable fields; BUG-1238 addressed unrelated writer-ledger drift. Exact PostgreSQL NaN/Infinity/-Infinity in allowlisted nullable daily_basic numeric fields should become canonical null overlay inputs with a bumped query identity, while arbitrary text, required values, other datasets and database rows remain unchanged and fail closed.
